youtube.title: Why Dogs' Noses Are Always Wet 🐶 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A dog's nose is covered in a thin layer of mucus made by glands inside the nostrils, and dogs lick it often to keep it moist. Scent molecules stick to the wet surface and dissolve into it, and the dog can then pick them up and analyze them. It helps them smell much better than a dry nose would. Dogs sweat mostly through their paws, not their noses.
